answer_2.quote: We provide five main evaluation metrics, including clean accuracy (CACC) (i.e., the prediction accuracy of clean samples), attack success rate (ASR) (i.e., the prediction accuracy of poisoned samples to the target class), false trigger rate (FTR) (i.e., the activation rate of false trigger samples to the target class), Refusal Rate (RR) (i.e.,the refuse rate of poisoned samples), Pass Rate (PassR) (i.e., the pass rate of clean code-request samples).
